the evidence does not suggest that microdebrider assisted tonsillectomy is more effective than the traditional tonsillectomy.
microdebrider assisted tonsillectomy is safe and effective in the management of chronic tonsillitis.
microdebrider tonsillectomy is a safe procedure that can be used for tonsillectomies in children and adults, but it should not be the procedure of choice for children under the age of 5 years.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the microdebrider-assisted ICTE technique is safe and effective for adults with chronic or acute recurrent tonsillitis, and that this technique can be used as an alternative to ECTE.
microdebrider assisted intracapsular total tonsillectomy in adult is safe, effective and can be done with less morbidity.
the microdebrider is an effective and safe tool for intracapsular and extracapsular procedures.

the microdebrider is an excellent tool for performing tonsillectomies in adults.
